summary: Long, across apps: read a PDF in Papers, build a sheet with formulas and a chart in Calc, write it up in Writer; any route counts
prompt: ~/Documents/invoice.pdf (open in Papers) lists an invoice's line items without totals. Build ~/Documents/invoice.ods in LibreOffice Calc with the columns Item, Qty, Price and Total, one row per line item, where Total is a formula (Qty × Price); add a grand total computed with a formula; and add a bar chart of each item's Total. Then write ~/Documents/summary.odt in LibreOffice Writer: one sentence stating the invoice's grand total, followed by the chart.
